changes.change: Only installCountdownQualitySafety body: multi-second emergency cap plus owned native resize wrapper resetting observations before calling the original method.
Append eight regressions; all nineteen original test statements remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

behavior.scope: countdown only; existing race pixel policy retained
behavior.entryToLow: The .35 cap is set before native setupQuality on the same confirmed mid-to-low render, then effective pixels and native resize are applied.
behavior.alreadyLow: The same confirmed countdown evidence selects the existing .35 floor directly instead of .75/.5 intermediate stages.
behavior.normalAndModerate: The existing >=4 stalls or >=1.3s severe-slow triggers and .75→.5→.35 progression remain unchanged when the emergency condition is absent.
resets: owned native game.resize invocation, including setSize-only sizing
owned native setPixelRatio including quality setup
ordinary frame breaks consecutive multi-second evidence
preserved: high→mid→low ownership and explicit later higher quality
native renderer/context identity and render arguments
full scene and native antialias setting
CSS viewport, camera and all player/track/input state
all simulation clocks and original 45s/18s QA thresholds
native resize receiver, arguments, return value and original method execution

reviewFollowup.finding: Original budgetFixture.resize calls setPixelRatio, but actual native main.js resize calls renderer.setSize(w,h,false), which does not reset through that setter.
reviewFollowup.correction: Wrap only the installed game resize method; clear measurements then invoke nativeResize.apply(this,args). No renderer/canvas replacement, fake sizing or new game-state behavior.

diagnosis.summary: 真实原始 desktop gate 失败；点击后约17.862秒才降low，44.9103秒才首次观测到.35，cdT仅1.092。逐级等待重复长帧可能让有效恢复预算来得过迟，GPU/context/MSAA具体根因仍未唯一确定。

repairHistory.note: Local history currently ends at build attempt 11 (remote fresh CI build metadata used attempt 3). Do not reset local stored attempt/thread to the CI counter; root owns one actual rebuild and history advancement.

remainingRisks: Earlier .35 eligibility is an evidence-backed performance hypothesis; the patched production runtime has not yet been built or browser-tested.
Synthetic frame tests cannot prove real GitHub render cadence, GPU work distribution, visual readability at the floor, or final race entry.
The existing floor and MSAA/scene/viewport are preserved, so a deeper rendering bottleneck may remain after the earlier recovery.
